notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon, For Other Minds shelf (drawn by platform/ci/creative_due.py). Piece: the-cheese-that-keeps-growing-in-the-cold (Kington, July 2054). Sources verified this session: Rosenow & Marth, J Food Prot 50(6):452-459 (1987) abstract via NCBI eutils (doubling times 29h44-45h33 at 4 C, 8h40-14h33 at 8 C); FSA 'How to chill, freeze and defrost food safely' (0-5 C, thermometer weekly, freezer pauses not kills); NHS listeriosis page (soft cheese/pregnancy unless steaming hot; higher-risk groups); Food Standards Scotland Listeria factsheet 2019 (growth limit -0.4 C). Arithmetic and 2054 weekdays computed in Python. Claimed proposal with a first commit, marked Done, bible_done.mjs moved it to DONE.md, added a new For Other Minds proposal (Allee effect; 'p-hacking' rejected as overlapping 'Toss It Again'). Checks: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 20/20 pass; check_posts.py ok. CI: changed-ventures red on an unwired tree check, portfolio/pipeline/test_validate_doc_consistency.py ('PyYAML is required' on the runner); not touched by this diff, and the 4 venture suites in that job passed (hearth-and-horizon 20 tests). Another session's commit (claude/gracious-ptolemy-1rkhrq, 'a runner without PyYAML skips it instead of failing') names this PR as hit by the same failure. Merged on the remaining green checks.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
